Ana (Support): Creating a follow-up thread for today's incident. Need clarity on: public status copy, timeline + owners for fixes, and process for sharing RCAs with customers who ask. Who takes what?

Ravi (SRE): I will own the immediate remediation (scaling rules + QA). Quick plan: roll temporary scaling patch within 48h, full fix (rate-limiter + chaos tests) in 12 days. I'll file INC-4399 now.

Priya (PM): Flagging pattern: we saw a similar queue-growth incident in Jan. I want a short "recurring incident" note in the postmortem and a follow-up action to harden autoscale tests. I can run the retro and own follow-ups.

Ravi (SRE): Tracker created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-4399 — assigned to SRE/infra. Key tasks added.

Jordan (Comms): Draft statuspage copy (short, non-technical):

"We experienced higher-than-normal API latency between 09:10 and 09:40 UTC which may have caused some requests to fail or be slower than usual. A mitigation has been applied and monitoring is ongoing. We'll post a public incident summary within 24 hours and a full RCA within 5 business days. If you were directly affected, contact support@redwood.ai for more details."

Liam (Sales): For enterprise customers we should prepare a private note that includes SLA impact and next steps. Also confirm timeline for redacted RCA so AE's can respond to customer inquiries.

Priya (PM): Decision proposal for RCA sharing: publish a public-facing summary on the status page and post a customer-facing summary doc. Provide redacted RCA to affected customers on request. Security sign-off required on redactions before sharing.

security-bot: Reminder: any RCA containing system diagrams, IPs, or raw logs must be reviewed by Security for redaction. Add ticket step: Security review.

Ravi (SRE): Action items (adding due dates):
- Ravi: temporary scaling patch (roll) — due 2026-03-02
- Ravi: full mitigation + tests — due 2026-03-14
- Priya: retro + recurring-incident plan — due 2026-03-06
- Jordan: statuspage short copy + public note — due 2026-03-01 (24h)
